research_step: align manuscript terminology with frozen public assets
statement_boundary: LG-MGL is the integrated workflow and not a third trained model; DenseGNN and PI-DenseGNN map to D06 and F06 respectively.
A source supports only the evidence units that explicitly cite it.

research_step: definition of what a 2PI candidate is evaluated on
statement_boundary: Evaluation criteria are not experimental validation of every endpoint.

research_step: construction of the frozen six-task corpus
statement_boundary: The values are QuantumChem-200K-derived reference/proxy labels and should not be described collectively as untouched experimental ground truth.

manuscript_concept: six predictive endpoints and molecular representation
statement_boundary: Endpoint definitions correspond to the frozen deployment assets; strict-clean retraining is a separate sensitivity audit. D06/DenseGNN is primary; F06/PI-DenseGNN is family-sensitive and diagnostic. General dense descriptors are not all directly literature-derived.

research_step: task-prior construction, model implementation and controlled sensitivity audit
statement_boundary: The weights are an implemented deployment-utility prior, not learned weights, measurement-authority scores or a predictive-performance optimum; no external LLM-generated role score was used.
The lowest observed ablation mean is comparative sensitivity evidence; it does not establish statistical superiority or replace frozen D06/F06 roles.
The completed independent comparison supports sigma_max and must not be expanded to all six tasks or to sigma_780 without an additional verified asset.
Applicability-domain tiers and D06/F06 disagreement are diagnostics/risk controls and are not formal calibrated uncertainty quantification.
Routing encodes admissibility, not mechanism proof.
Route classes describe provenance strength only and are not candidate scores; literature route precedent is not candidate-specific synthesis validation.

Large-library deployment is an application of the framework, not an independent methodological innovation. The public evidence begins at the qualified 9,939-record pool and does not establish exhaustive processing of all ZINC22 molecules.

manuscript_concept: representative selection and QM evidence tier
statement_boundary: The output is a QM-assessed candidate portfolio, not experimentally validated leads. Type-I closure is candidate-specific; Type-II evidence is ET-proxy rather than full pair Gibbs DeltaG_ET; SET/PET assignments remain exploratory.
